integrity.numerical_limit: Finite numerical experiments are corroborative, not proofs.
integrity.proof_scope: All positive aspect ratios; exact integration and analytic shape inversion.
integrity.reproducibility: verify_core_crossing.py independently computes quadrature and random Euclidean-lift distances.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the intrinsic flat metric of a compact Mobius band with totally geodesic boundary; it makes no assertion of a smooth Euclidean-space embedding.
A minimizing geodesic is unique for almost every sampled endpoint pair; ties require an arbitrary convention only on a null set.
Historical priority was evaluated from accessible sources and remains provisional; no independent literature or mathematical audit has occurred.
title: A core-crossing law that determines the shape of a flat Möbius band
